mapper.select: select date(order_time) as date, coalesce(sum(case when status = 5 and pay_status = 1 then amount else 0 end), 0) as turnover, count(*) as order_count, sum(case when status = 5 and pay_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as valid_order_count from orders where order_time >= #{begin} and order_time < #{end} group by date(order_time) order by date asc

with ranked_sales as ( select case when d.dish_id is not null then 1 else 2 end as product_type, coalesce(d.dish_id, d.setmeal_id) as product_id, d.name, sum(d.number) over (partition by d.dish_id, d.setmeal_id) as number, row_number() over ( partition by d.dish_id, d.setmeal_id order by o.order_time desc, o.id desc, d.id desc ) as snapshot_rank from orders o inner join order_detail d on o.id = d.order_id where o.order_time >= #{begin} and o.order_time < #{end} and o.status = 5 and o.pay_status = 1 and d.number > 0 and ((d.dish_id > 0 and d.setmeal_id is null) or (d.setmeal_id > 0 and d.dish_id is null)) ) select product_type, product_id, name, number from ranked_sales where snapshot_rank = 1 order by number desc, product_type asc, product_id asc limit 10
